Bash(1 <<'EOF'
SELECT p.packageId, p.packageName,
       paAny.availCount AS availCount,
       paNext.nextDate AS nextAvailableDate
FROM packages p
LEFT JOIN \(
    SELECT packageId, COUNT\(*\) AS availCount
    FROM package_availability
    GROUP BY packageId
\) paAny ON paAny.packageId = p.packageId
LEFT JOIN \(
    SELECT pa.packageId, MIN\(pa.availableDate\) AS nextDate
    FROM package_availability pa
    LEFT JOIN \(
        SELECT packageId, DATE\(departureDate\) AS d,
               SUM\(COALESCE\(adults,0\) + COALESCE\(children,0\) + COALESCE\(infants,0\)\) AS booked
        FROM bookings
        WHERE \(bookingStatus IS NULL OR bookingStatus NOT IN \('cancelled','rejected'\)\)
          AND \(paymentStatus IS NULL OR paymentStatus <> 'refunded'\)
        GROUP BY packageId, DATE\(departureDate\)
    \) b
      ON b.packageId = pa.packageId
     AND b.d = pa.availableDate
    WHERE pa.availableDate >= CURDATE\(\)
      AND pa.status IN \('available','confirmed'\)
      AND \(pa.availableSeats - COALESCE\(b.booked,0\)\) > 0
    GROUP BY pa.packageId
\) paNext ON paNext.packageId = p.packageId
WHERE p.isActive = 1
  AND \(p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'active'\)
  AND p.sales_target = 'B2B'
  AND \(p.sales_start_date IS NULL OR p.sales_start_date <= CURDATE\(\)\)
  AND \(p.sales_end_date IS NULL OR p.sales_end_date >= CURDATE\(\)\)
GROUP BY p.packageId
HAVING \( \(COALESCE\(availCount,0\) > 0 AND nextAvailableDate IS NOT NULL\) OR \(COALESCE\(availCount,0\) = 0 AND COALESCE\(p.maxParticipants,0\) > 0\) \);
EOF)

Bash(1 <<'EOF'
SELECT 
    b.bookingStatus,
    COUNT\(*\) as cnt,
    SUM\(CASE WHEN b.downPaymentConfirmedAt IS NOT NULL AND b.downPaymentConfirmedAt != '0000-00-00 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as downConfirmed,
    SUM\(CASE WHEN b.advancePaymentConfirmedAt IS NOT NULL AND b.advancePaymentConfirmedAt != '0000-00-00 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as secondConfirmed,
    SUM\(CASE WHEN b.balanceConfirmedAt IS NOT NULL AND b.balanceConfirmedAt != '0000-00-00 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as balanceConfirmed
FROM bookings b
WHERE b.advancePaymentAmount IS NOT NULL 
  AND b.advancePaymentAmount > 0
  AND \(
    b.downPaymentAmount != \(5000 * \(b.adults + b.children\)\)
    OR b.advancePaymentAmount != \(
        10000 * \(b.adults + b.children\) 
        + \(SELECT COALESCE\(SUM\(CASE WHEN t.visaType = 'group' THEN 1500 WHEN t.visaType = 'individual' THEN 1900 ELSE 0 END\), 0\) FROM booking_travelers t WHERE t.transactNo = b.transactNo\)
        + COALESCE\(\(SELECT SUM\(bto.price\) FROM booking_traveler_options bto WHERE bto.booking_id = b.bookingId\), 0\)
    \)
  \)
GROUP BY b.bookingStatus
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
EOF)

Bash(1 <<'EOF'
SELECT 
    b.bookingId,
    DATE\(b.createdAt\) as createdDate,
    \(b.adults + b.children\) as pax,
    b.infants,
    b.totalAmount as storedTotal,
    b.packagePrice,
    
    -- Down + Second + Balance 합계
    \(b.downPaymentAmount + b.advancePaymentAmount + b.balanceAmount\) as sumPayments,
    
    -- 차이
    \(b.totalAmount - \(b.downPaymentAmount + b.advancePaymentAmount + b.balanceAmount\)\) as diff
    
FROM bookings b
WHERE b.advancePaymentAmount IS NOT NULL 
  AND b.advancePaymentAmount > 0
  AND b.bookingStatus NOT IN \('cancelled', 'rejected', 'confirmed'\)
HAVING diff != 0
ORDER BY ABS\(diff\) DESC
LIMIT 30;
EOF)

        10000 * \(b.adults + b.children\) 
        + \(SELECT COALESCE\(SUM\(CASE WHEN t.visaType = 'group' THEN 1500 WHEN t.visaType = 'individual' THEN 1900 ELSE 0 END\), 0\) FROM booking_travelers t WHERE t.transactNo = b.transactNo\)
        + COALESCE\(\(SELECT SUM\(bto.price\) FROM booking_traveler_options bto WHERE bto.booking_id = b.bookingId\), 0\)
    \)
  \)
ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC;
EOF)
